name: real-time-stocks-data-explorer
description: Root scripts delegate to frontend/; run npm install in frontend/ first.

scripts.allure:merge: python3 scripts/merge_allure_results.py allure-results/merged allure-results/backend allure-results/frontend-unit allure-results/frontend-e2e allure-results/k3s-smoke
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:merge && rm -rf allure-report && npx --prefix frontend allure generate allure-results/merged -o allure-report
